name: Binyuu Inmai Haruka "Watashi ni Iyarashii Cosplay Saseru nante... Kono Hentai!"
original_name: 美乳淫妹 遥 「私にイヤらしいコスプレさせるなんて……この変態！」
source:
The main character, a prefect, lives with his younger sister, Haruka. He loves Oppai and cosplay girls. Though he keeps it secret at school, there are a lot of cosplay uniforms in his room. Of course, Haruka dislikes him.... One day, she finds a tissue paper her older brother used for masturbation in a dust box.
